title: Seed selection and storage guide
context: Smallholder farmers and extension workers need plain-language, source-cited guidance on seed selection and storage.
objective: Write a plain-language guide to seed selection and storage summarizing established practice: why it matters, the practice, common mistakes, and sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers seed selection and storage as established general practice
General educational guidance only; no farm-specific prescriptions or pesticide dosing
Cites >=2 authoritative open sources with links
